text_block_list.text:
A theme park offering period drama experiences has reportedly become quite popular lately.
Curious, I paid it a visit—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Kunoichi Creek, reporting for duty.
Fufufu~, Taishin-chan, how do I look~?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Don't ask me... 
Well... I guess it doesn't look bad on you.
choice_data_list: You two came here too, huh?
You two came here too, huh?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: My, my, are you participating in the sword fight show too~?
choice_data_list: A sword fight show... What's that?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. It's an interactive swordplay play for visitors.
We're about to take part in it~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: From what I hear, a corrupt magistrate and a village maiden will show up on the main street, causing a bit of a commotion.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: The script has Taishin-chan and me dashing in gallantly to rescue her♪

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm just appearing in it, I'm not doing any standout roles.
...I'm pretty sure I told you that earlier.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hmm... But putting on a big sword fight together would be so much fun, wouldn't it~?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
When I say no, I mean no.
I'm Villager A. That's it.

text_block_list.name: Corrupt Magistrate
text_block_list.text: You village wench~, were you the one who dared soil my hakama?!

text_block_list.name: Village Girl
text_block_list.text:
I-It's a misunderstanding!
I didn't do anything...!

text_block_list.name: Corrupt Magistrate
text_block_list.text:
Silence! Spare me your useless drivel!
Seize this girl at once!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, it's almost time for our entrance.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, oh? Oh dear me~?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Creek-san?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Look at that.
The sole of your boot is peeling off.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Yes... And there are no replacements around, so I'm a li~ttle stuck.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: What should we do... At this rate, the event will be ruined—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I'll buy us some time. Creek-san, go fix that with some glue or whatever.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Eh? But Taishin-chan, didn't you really hate standing out...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Just go!

text_block_list.name: Corrupt Magistrate
text_block_list.text: Gwahahaha~, now then, what shall we do with this village girl, eh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh, made it! Ah~~...
H-"Hold it right there, corrupt magistrate!"

text_block_list.name: Corrupt Magistrate
text_block_list.text:
Nani-kore?! ...*ahem*!
Who goes there? Just who do you think I am?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Like I'd know... wait, no, uhh...! 
"Status means nothing to someone causing outrage on the open highway!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, nice one, nice one!
Get 'im, missy!
choice_data_list: This isn't what I heard, but... give it your all!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Hmph.
I don't care how many there are, I'll kick—slash them all down!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Toryaaaaaa!

text_block_list.name: Corrupt Magistrate
text_block_list.text:
Gnuuugh, men, to arms, to arms!
Don't tell me we're being bested by mere villagers!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. In that case, Mama will
lend a splendid helping hand too~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"Never has evil triumphed in this world.
Even if the authorities turn a blind eye,
this super kunoichi and the brave villager will—"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Umm... r... "Right the wrongs,
and the absurdities of this fleeting world...!"

And so, through the heroic efforts of the ninja and the villager,
the corrupt magistrate and his retinue were rounded up in one fell swoop.
choice_data_list: If there was trouble, I could've helped out too.
If there was trouble, I could've helped out too.

text_block_list.text:
And so, through the heroic efforts of the ninja and the villager,
the corrupt magistrate and his retinue were rounded up in one fell swoop.
choice_data_list: If there was trouble, I could've helped out too.
If there was trouble, I could've helped out too.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Well... this much is nothing...
choice_data_list: If anything, you were the one saving Creek.
If anything, you were the one saving Creek.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Uuu, you've grown up so splendidly...
Could it be that you're outgrowing your Mama?
Does this mean I won't get to pat your head anymore—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Not really...
Nothing's changed from before, right?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
...Taishin-cha~n!
I knew you were a good girl after all, weren't you~♪

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I don't need that.
You could tell just by watching, right?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Man oh man~, nicely done, missy!
That really cleared the air!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah! That whole twist with the villager standing up was super hype~!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: No... I only stepped in because the lead got caught up in trouble and wouldn't make it in time—

Surrounded and showered with praise,
Narita Taishin seemed somewhat proud of herself.
